name: Huanxiang Xiang: Youzui Tuiding ~Yeming qian de Sansejin
original_name: 幻想乡：有罪推定~夜明前的三色堇
source:
Explore the intertwined fates of humans and youkai in this interactive fiction. As an unwitting protagonist, enter the sealed realm of Gensokyo to investigate a series of bizarre murders. Unearth ancient secrets and witness a gripping saga hidden for millennia.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2325310]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这部互动小说中探索人类和妖怪交织在一起的命运。作为一名不知情的主角，进入幻想乡的密封国度，调查一系列离奇的谋杀案。揭开古老的秘密，见证隐藏了数千年的扣人心弦的传奇故事。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2325310]Steam[/url]]
